description: This Kotlin source file defines the SearchViewModel class for managing search-related UI state and interactions in an Android app, including search queries, search results, recent searches, and user interactions such as bookmarking and following topics.

classes.name: SearchViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel managing search UI state, handling search queries, results, recent searches, and user interactions such as bookmarking and following topics.

methods.name: onSearchQueryChanged
methods.description: Updates the saved state handle with the new search query.

methods.name: onSearchTriggered
methods.description: Handles explicit search trigger, saves the query to recent searches, and logs the event.

methods.name: clearRecentSearches
methods.description: Clears the list of recent searches.

methods.name: setNewsResourceBookmarked
methods.description: Marks a news resource as bookmarked or unbookmarked.

methods.name: followTopic
methods.description: Follows or unfollows a topic based on user action.

methods.name: setNewsResourceViewed
methods.description: Marks a news resource as viewed.
